title: Okiraku Ryoushu no Tanoshii Ryouchi Bouei: Seisankei Majutsu de Na mo Naki Mura wo Saikyou no Jousai Toshi ni
synopsis: Van, the fourth son of a powerful noble, is only two years old when he remembers his past life as a salaryman in Japan. With his adult brain in a young body, he's considered a child prodigy...until he...
synopsis_es: Van, el cuarto hijo de un poderoso noble, tiene sólo dos años cuando recuerda su vida pasada como asalariado en Japón. Con su cerebro adulto en un cuerpo joven, se le considera un niño prodigio... hasta que...
background: Each episode was streamed three days in advance of the TV broadcast starting on January 7, 2026, on Prime Video and Crunchyroll. Regular broadcasting began on January 10, 2026.

episodes_data.title: The Young Genius's Harsh Expulsion from His Home
episodes_data.description: A reincarnated Van trains relentlessly until his powerful magic leads his dismayed father to cast him out.
episodes_data.title_es: La dura expulsión del joven genio de su hogar

episodes_data.title: The Proper Way to Use Weak Magic
episodes_data.description: Van arrives to find his new village under attack, so he defends his people, then plans for their future.
episodes_data.title_es: La forma correcta de usar magia débil

episodes_data.title: The Wonderful Renovation of an Impoverished Frontier
episodes_data.description: Van strengthens village defenses as adventurers uncover signs of a nearby dungeon.
episodes_data.title_es: La maravillosa renovación de una frontera empobrecida

episodes_data.title: Rushed Hospitality and a Busy Emissary Visit
episodes_data.description: Van`s victory is followed by visits from merchants and then an emissary from the neighboring county.
episodes_data.title_es: Hospitalidad apresurada y visita de un emisario ocupado

episodes_data.title: A Rare Species' Passionate Engagement Competition
episodes_data.description: Apkallu appear on the shores of Van`s lake and Van gets dragged into a competition with his marriage at stake.
episodes_data.title_es: Un apasionado concurso de compromiso de especies raras

episodes_data.title: Slaying a Dangerous Forest Dragon with Large Ballistae
episodes_data.description: A forest dragon attacks the village, so Van rallies his forces who fight for the survival of the village.
episodes_data.title_es: Matando a un peligroso dragón del bosque con grandes balistas

episodes_data.title: Earnest Merchants and Receiving a Proud Title
episodes_data.description: Bell & Rango refuse to let Van be swindled. Panamera visits the capital to secure a title for Van.
episodes_data.title_es: Comerciantes serios y recibiendo un título orgulloso

episodes_data.title: A Postapocalyptic Band's Rowdy Dungeon Exploration
episodes_data.description: Ortho`s party accidentally discovers the dungeon, forcing them to report it, which attracts wild adventurers.
episodes_data.title_es: La ruidosa exploración de mazmorras de una banda postapocalíptica

episodes_data.title: The Timid Girl's Beautiful Marionette Dance
episodes_data.description: Arte puts on a dance performance with her marionette magic, and the king visits to see Van`s handiwork.
episodes_data.title_es: El hermoso baile de marionetas de la niña tímida

episodes_data.title: A Secret Weapon's Villainous Attack on the Homeland
episodes_data.description: After defending Seatoh Village from the Kingdom of Yelenetta, Van`s forces must ride to Scudett`s defense.
episodes_data.title_es: El malvado ataque de un arma secreta a la patria

episodes_data.title: The Ultimate Squad's Proud Counterattack
episodes_data.description: Scuderia`s forces carry out the operation to retake Scudett Fortress.
episodes_data.title_es: El orgulloso contraataque del Ultimate Squad

episodes_data.title: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord
episodes_data.description: Arte defends her homeland from Yelenetta Kingdom`s assault.
episodes_data.title_es: Defensa tranquila del territorio por parte del señor optimista
